issues.description: The template's make_y_state function signature omits the depolarization probability parameter 'p' that is required by the problem specification and is present in the reference solution. This mismatch will prevent students from implementing the function as specified and will cause confusion or test failures (the problem and solution expect make_y_state(circ, q, p)).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template's make_y_state function signature to include the depolarization probability parameter (p: float), i.e. def make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None:, and adjust the docstring to document the parameter. Ensure tests and example usage in the template use the same signature.
